core_obligations: Assuming (1), take N = Hom_R(M, R) and the evaluation map M tensor_R N -> R, and show it is an isomorphism by checking after localizing at an f with M_f isomorphic to R_f and invoking a cover argument (proof lines 36130-36135).

Show (3) implies (2) by observing that K -> K tensor_R N is a quasi-inverse to K -> K tensor_R M, and conversely that invertibility makes K -> K tensor_R M essentially surjective (proof lines 36138-36141).
Assume (2) and (3) and let psi : M tensor_R N -> R be the isomorphism; choose xi = sum x_i tensor y_i with psi(xi) = 1 (proof lines 36144-36147).
Use the displayed isomorphisms M -> M tensor_R M tensor_R N -> M to conclude that the map x -> sum psi(x tensor y_i) x_i is an automorphism of M (proof lines 36148-36153).

Factor that automorphism as M -> R^{oplus n} -> M with the displayed arrows, concluding that M is a direct summand of a finite free R-module and therefore finite locally free (proof lines 36154-36163).
Apply the same argument to N by symmetry and use M tensor_R N isomorphic to R to conclude that M and N both have rank 1 (proof lines 36164-36166).
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the equivalence of three conditions on a module M over a ring R: that M be finite locally free of rank 1, that M be invertible, and that there exist an R-module N with M tensor_R N isomorphic to R, together with the identification of the N in the third condition as Hom_R(M, R) (source lines 36117-36127). The proof is a three-way cycle of implications plus a rank argument. It first takes N = Hom_R(M, R) and the evaluation map, shows the evaluation map is an isomorphism by reducing to localizations at which M becomes free and invoking a cover argument (proof lines 36130-36135). The equivalence of invertibility with the existence of an inverse module is then a statement about tensor functors forming a quasi-inverse pair, with essential surjectivity for the converse (proof lines 36138-36141). The final and substantive part deduces finite local freeness: from an isomorphism psi : M tensor_R N -> R and an element xi = sum x_i tensor y_i with psi(xi) = 1, the proof exhibits the automorphism x -> sum psi(x tensor y_i) x_i of M and factors it through R^{oplus n}, so that M is a direct summand of a finite free module, hence finite locally free; applying the same to N by symmetry and using M tensor_R N isomorphic to R forces both to have rank 1 (proof lines 36144-36166). The non-routine content is the factoring of an automorphism through a finite free module, which is what produces the direct summand.
